name: ImmortalWrt 多機型模組化極速編譯 (BIN/ITB 並行・新正式版自動偵測・每月1日自動編譯)

# =============================================================================
# 【最頂層模組化設定區】機型清單、網路憑證、自動編譯排程與加速策略
# 直接修改下方預設值即可全鏈路生效（編譯預置 + 首次開機配置 + 發布頁自動同步說明）
# （註：GitHub Actions 單一工作流 inputs 上限為 10 項，已全數保留給下方 6 個插件 Y/N 與 4 個建置選項）
# =============================================================================
env:
  TZ: Asia/Taipei

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. 編譯機型模組化清單（支援直接依 https://firmware-selector.immortalwrt.org/ 增刪）
  #    格式：target/subtarget|profile_id|顯示名稱|硬體規格備註
  #    查詢方式：前往 https://firmware-selector.immortalwrt.org/ 搜尋機型，
  #      - target/subtarget：頁面中顯示的「Target」(如 mediatek/filogic、qualcommax/ipq807x、x86/64)
  #      - profile_id：網址參數 ?id= 後方字串或韌體檔名中的機型代號 (如 glinet_gl-mt3600be)
  #    簡寫相容：僅填 target/subtarget|profile_id 或僅填 profile_id (預設 mediatek/filogic) 亦可自動識別；
  #              若加入不同 target/subtarget 的機型，系統將自動啟動多台 GitHub Runner 跨架構並行編譯！
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DEVICES_CONFIG: |
    mediatek/filogic|cudy_tr3000-v1|Cudy TR3000 v1|MediaTek MT7981B · 128MB SPI-NAND（112MB 大分區）
    mediatek/filogic|jdcloud_re-cp-03|京東雲無線寶 AX6000 百里|MediaTek MT7986A · eMMC 高速儲存
    mediatek/filogic|cmcc_rax3000m-emmc|中國移動 RAX3000M 算力版|MediaTek MT7981B · eMMC 高速儲存
    mediatek/filogic|glinet_gl-mt3600be|GL.iNet GL-MT3600BE|MediaTek MT7987A · Wi-Fi 7 (BE3600)

  # 當某機型在所選舊版分支尚未獲上游收錄時的處理方式：
  # Y = 印出警告並自動略過該機型（不中斷其餘機型編譯，並於發布頁明確標註）
  # N = 嚴格報錯並中止編譯（同時列出該平台可用機型供核對）
  SKIP_UNSUPPORTED_DEVICE: 'Y'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. 網路與預設登入憑證模組
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DEFAULT_LAN_IP: '192.168.7.1'          # 預設 LAN 管理 IP (僅限合法 IPv4，如 192.168.7.1 / 192.168.1.1 / 10.0.0.1)
  DEFAULT_HOSTNAME: 'ImmortalWrt'        # 預設路由器主機名稱
  DEFAULT_LOGIN_USER: 'root'             # 預設管理員帳號 (預設 root；若改為如 admin，將自動建立完整 LuCI/SSH 權限帳號)
  DEFAULT_LOGIN_PASS: ''                 # 預設登入密碼 (留空 '' 表示免密碼登入；填寫字串如 'password' 則自動雜湊寫入並於發布頁註明)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. 系統底層加速模組 (Y = 整合 / N = 不整合)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PLUGIN_BBR: 'Y'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. 自動編譯規則設定（新正式版自動觸發 + 每月 1 日凌晨 00:00 例行自動編譯）
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AUTO_BUILD_ENABLED: 'Y'                # Y = 開啟上游巡檢，僅於 ImmortalWrt 發佈新正式版時自動編譯 / N = 關閉巡檢
  MONTHLY_BUILD_ENABLED: 'Y'             # Y = 開啟每月 1 日凌晨 00:00 (台北/北京時間 UTC+8) 例行自動編譯 / N = 關閉月度編譯
  AUTO_BUILD_BRANCH: 'latest-release-1'  # 自動追蹤目標：latest-release-1 (最新穩定正式版) 或 latest-snapshot (開發快照版)
  AUTO_BUILD_FORMAT: 'bin'               # 自動編譯格式：bin / itb / both (both 啟動雙 Runner 並行編譯雙格式)
  AUTO_BUILD_TARGETS: 'all'              # 自動編譯機型：all (全部 DEVICES_CONFIG) 或逗號分隔之 profile_id
  AUTO_BUILD_VARIANTS: 'all'             # 自動編譯規格：all (Std + Pro) / Pro / Std
  AUTO_BUILD_TRACK_PLUGINS: 'N'          # N = 僅監測 ImmortalWrt 新正式版，不因 mihomo Alpha 核心頻繁更新觸發自動編譯；Y = 同步監測插件

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. 編譯極速加速策略
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ENABLE_TOOLCHAIN_CACHE: 'Y'            # Y = 啟用預編譯工具鏈獨立快取 (命中時直省 20~35 分鐘)

on:
  schedule:
    # 1. 每 6 小時巡檢一次 ImmortalWrt 官方新正式版（台北/北京時間 02:00 / 08:00 / 14:00 / 20:00）
    #    僅在新正式版發佈時觸發編譯；無新版本約 15 秒跳過，零編譯耗時
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
    # 2. 每月 1 日凌晨 00:00（台北/北京時間 UTC+8）例行自動編譯
    #    GitHub cron 固定採用 UTC（UTC 16:00 = UTC+8 隔日 00:00），因各月天數不同故於 28-31 日喚醒，
    #    並由 prepare 階段精準核對台北時間為「01 號」才放行（非 1 號約 3 秒直接跳過）
    - cron: '0 16 28-31 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      # =======================================================================
      # 插件模組管理區 (Y = 整合 / N = 不整合)
      # =======================================================================
      plugin_nikki:
        description: '【插件・Pro】Nikki 透明代理 + 最新 Alpha-Smart 核心 (Y=整合 / N=不整合)'
        required: false
        default: 'Y'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'Y'
          - 'N'
      plugin_rtp2httpd:
        description: '【插件・Pro】rtp2httpd 原生 C 版 IPTV 串流轉發 (Y=整合 / N=不整合)'
        required: false
        default: 'Y'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'Y'
          - 'N'
      plugin_argon:
        description: '【插件・基礎】Argon 視覺主題並設為預設主題 (Y=整合 / N=改回預設 Bootstrap)'
        required: false
        default: 'Y'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'Y'
          - 'N'
      plugin_ttyd:
        description: '【插件・基礎】TTYD Web 網頁終端機 (Y=整合 / N=不整合)'
        required: false
        default: 'Y'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'Y'
          - 'N'
      plugin_sftp:
        description: '【插件・基礎】OpenSSH SFTP 檔案管理 + Avahi mDNS 發現 (Y=整合 / N=不整合)'
        required: false
        default: 'Y'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'Y'
          - 'N'
      plugin_wwan:
        description: '【插件・基礎】5G/4G 行動寬頻模組與手機 USB 共享驅動 (Y=整合 / N=不整合)'
        required: false
        default: 'Y'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'Y'
          - 'N'

      # =======================================================================
      # 核心建置參數區
      # =======================================================================
      source_branch:
        description: '選擇編譯版本 (預設 latest-release-1 為最新穩定版；自動追蹤最新 3 個穩定版與最新 1 個 SNAPSHOT 版)'
        required: false
        default: 'latest-release-1'
        type: choice
        options:
          - latest-release-1
          - latest-release-2
          - latest-release-3
          - latest-snapshot
      image_format:
        description: '選擇編譯原生韌體格式 (bin 適配 Yuzhii U-Boot；itb 為官方 FIT；both 雙 Runner 並行編譯雙格式)'
        required: false
        default: 'bin'
        type: choice
        options:
          - bin
          - itb
          - both
      target_filter:
        description: '篩選編譯機型 (預設 all 編譯頂部 DEVICES_CONFIG 全部機型；亦可填單一或逗號分隔之 profile_id，如 glinet_gl-mt3600be)'
        required: false
        default: 'all'
        type: string
      variant_filter:
        description: '選擇韌體版本規格 (all 為增量雙階段編譯 Std + Pro；亦可單獨編譯 Std 或 Pro)'
        required: false
        default: 'all'
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - Pro
          - Std

# 最小權限原則：頂層清空權限，僅於必要階段授予最小權限
permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-${{ inputs.source_branch || 'auto' }}-${{ inputs.image_format || 'auto' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  # ===========================================================================
  # 階段 1：輕量元資料解析、機型矩陣規劃與上游變動 / 月度排程判定 (約 10~15 秒)
  # ===========================================================================
  prepare:
    name: 解析機型矩陣與巡檢上游 (Prepare & Check Upstream)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      should_build: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.should_build }}
      trigger_label: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.trigger_label }}
      change_reason: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.change_reason }}
      upstream_fingerprint: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.upstream_fingerprint }}
      source_ref: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.source_ref }}
      resolved_ver: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.resolved_ver }}
      img_fmt: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.img_fmt }}
      tc_matrix_json: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tc_matrix_json }}
      build_matrix_json: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.build_matrix_json }}
      devices_json: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.devices_json }}
      variants: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.variants }}
      lan_ip: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.lan_ip }}
      hostname: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.hostname }}
      login_user: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.login_user }}
      login_pass: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.login_pass }}
      need_pro: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.need_pro }}
      need_nikki: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.need_nikki }}
      need_rtp2httpd: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.need_rtp2httpd }}
      has_pro_plugins: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.has_pro_plugins }}
      enable_nikki: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.enable_nikki }}
      enable_rtp2httpd: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.enable_rtp2httpd }}
      enable_argon: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.enable_argon }}
      enable_ttyd: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.enable_ttyd }}
      enable_sftp: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.enable_sftp }}
      enable_wwan: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.enable_wwan }}
      enable_bbr: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.enable_bbr }}
      enable_tc_cache: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.enable_tc_cache }}
      skip_unsupported: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.skip_unsupported }}
      build_start_time: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.build_start_time }}
      cache_week: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.cache_week }}
    steps:
      - name: 解析機型清單、驗證參數並執行自動觸發判定
        id: meta
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          SCHEDULE_CRON: ${{ github.event.schedule || '' }}
          REPO_FULL: ${{ github.repository }}
          INPUT_PLUGIN_NIKKI: ${{ inputs.plugin_nikki || 'Y' }}
          INPUT_PLUGIN_RTP2HTTPD: ${{ inputs.plugin_rtp2httpd || 'Y' }}
          INPUT_PLUGIN_ARGON: ${{ inputs.plugin_argon || 'Y' }}
          INPUT_PLUGIN_TTYD: ${{ inputs.plugin_ttyd || 'Y' }}
          INPUT_PLUGIN_SFTP: ${{ inputs.plugin_sftp || 'Y' }}
          INPUT_PLUGIN_WWAN: ${{ inputs.plugin_wwan || 'Y' }}
          INPUT_SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.source_branch || 'latest-release-1' }}
          INPUT_IMAGE_FORMAT: ${{ inputs.image_format || 'bin' }}
          INPUT_TARGET_FILTER: ${{ inputs.target_filter || '' }}
          INPUT_VARIANT_FILTER: ${{ inputs.variant_filter || 'all' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          retry() {
            local max_attempts=$1; shift
            local attempt=1
            until "$@"; do
              if [ "$attempt" -ge "$max_attempts" ]; then
                return 1
              fi
              echo "::warning::指令執行失敗 (第 ${attempt}/${max_attempts} 次)，等待重試..."
              sleep $((attempt * 3))
              attempt=$((attempt + 1))
            done
          }

          norm_yn() {
            local val="${1:-Y}"
            case "${val^^}" in
              Y|YES|TRUE|1) echo "Y" ;;
              N|NO|FALSE|0) echo "N" ;;
              *)
                echo "::error::無效的開關值 '${val}'，僅支援 Y 或 N！" >&2
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          }

          AUTO_ENABLED=$(norm_yn "${AUTO_BUILD_ENABLED:-Y}")
          MONTHLY_ENABLED=$(norm_yn "${MONTHLY_BUILD_ENABLED:-Y}")
          TRACK_PLUGINS=$(norm_yn "${AUTO_BUILD_TRACK_PLUGINS:-N}")
          ENABLE_TC_CACHE=$(norm_yn "${ENABLE_TOOLCHAIN_CACHE:-Y}")
          SKIP_UNSUPPORTED=$(norm_yn "${SKIP_UNSUPPORTED_DEVICE:-Y}")

          TAIPEI_DAY=$(TZ=Asia/Taipei date "+%d")
          TAIPEI_YM=$(TZ=Asia/Taipei date "+%Y-%m")
          BUILD_START_TIME=$(TZ=Asia/Taipei date "+%Y年%m月%d日 %H時%M分")
          CACHE_WEEK=$(TZ=Asia/Taipei date "+%G-W%V")

          # 快速門控：若為月度排程 (0 16 28-31 * *) 但台北時間尚未進入 01 日，3 秒直接結束不消耗資源
          IS_MONTHLY_TRIGGER="false"
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "schedule" ] && [ "$SCHEDULE_CRON" = "0 16 28-31 * *" ]; then
            if [ "$TAIPEI_DAY" != "01" ]; then
              echo "目前台北時間為 ${BUILD_START_TIME}（非每月 1 日 00:00），直接略過本次月度排程檢查。"
              {
                echo "### ⏭️ 月度排程日期檢查 — 非每月 1 日，已略過"
                echo "- **目前時間 (Asia/Taipei)**: ${BUILD_START_TIME}"
                echo "- **說明**: GitHub cron 使用 UTC，於每月 28–31 日 UTC 16:00 喚醒並僅在對應台北時間為 **每月 1 日 00:00** 時觸發編譯。"
              } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              {
                echo "should_build=false"
                echo "tc_matrix_json=[]"
                echo "build_matrix_json=[]"
                echo "devices_json=[]"
              } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
            IS_MONTHLY_TRIGGER="true"
          fi

          ENABLE_NIKKI=$(norm_yn "${INPUT_PLUGIN_NIKKI:-Y}")
          ENABLE_RTP2HTTPD=$(norm_yn "${INPUT_PLUGIN_RTP2HTTPD:-Y}")
          ENABLE_ARGON=$(norm_yn "${INPUT_PLUGIN_ARGON:-Y}")
          ENABLE_TTYD=$(norm_yn "${INPUT_PLUGIN_TTYD:-Y}")
          ENABLE_SFTP=$(norm_yn "${INPUT_PLUGIN_SFTP:-Y}")
          ENABLE_WWAN=$(norm_yn "${INPUT_PLUGIN_WWAN:-Y}")
          ENABLE_BBR=$(norm_yn "${PLUGIN_BBR:-Y}")

          LAN_IP="${DEFAULT_LAN_IP:-192.168.7.1}"
          HOSTNAME_VAL="${DEFAULT_HOSTNAME:-ImmortalWrt}"
          LOGIN_USER="${DEFAULT_LOGIN_USER:-root}"
          LOGIN_PASS="${DEFAULT_LOGIN_PASS-}"

          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "schedule" ]; then
            CHOICE="${AUTO_BUILD_BRANCH:-latest-release-1}"
            IMG_FMT="${AUTO_BUILD_FORMAT:-bin}"
            TARGET_FILTER="${AUTO_BUILD_TARGETS:-all}"
            VARIANT_FILTER="${AUTO_BUILD_VARIANTS:-all}"
            if [ "$IS_MONTHLY_TRIGGER" = "true" ]; then
              TRIGGER_LABEL="每月 1 日定期自動編譯 (monthly schedule)"
            else
              TRIGGER_LABEL="新正式版自動巡檢 (release schedule)"
            fi
          else
            CHOICE="${INPUT_SOURCE_BRANCH:-latest-release-1}"
            IMG_FMT="${INPUT_IMAGE_FORMAT:-bin}"
            TARGET_FILTER="${INPUT_TARGET_FILTER:-all}"
            VARIANT_FILTER="${INPUT_VARIANT_FILTER:-all}"
            TRIGGER_LABEL="手動觸發 (workflow_dispatch)"
          fi

          # 1. 驗證網路/憑證參數，並解析頂部模組化機型清單 + 產生跨架構/多格式並行矩陣
          PARSED_META=$(python3 - "$LAN_IP" "$HOSTNAME_VAL" "$LOGIN_USER" "$LOGIN_PASS" "$TARGET_FILTER" "$IMG_FMT" << 'PYEOF'
          import ipaddress
          import json
          import os
          import re
          import sys

          lan_ip, hostname, user, pwd, target_filter, img_fmt = sys.argv[1:7]

          # --- 參數校驗 ---
          try:
              ip_obj = ipaddress.IPv4Address(lan_ip)
              if ip_obj.is_unspecified or ip_obj.is_multicast or str(ip_obj) == "255.255.255.255":
                  raise ValueError("保留或無效廣播位址")
          except Exception as e:
              print(f"::error::DEFAULT_LAN_IP='{lan_ip}' 不是合法的 IPv4 位址 ({e})！", file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?', hostname):
              print(f"::error::DEFAULT_HOSTNAME='{hostname}' 格式無效（僅支援英數字與連字號）！", file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}', user):
              print(f"::error::DEFAULT_LOGIN_USER='{user}' 格式無效（須以小寫字母或底線開頭，僅含小寫英數字、_、-）！", file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          if "\n" in pwd or "\r" in pwd:
              print("::error::DEFAULT_LOGIN_PASS 不允許包含換行字元！", file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          if img_fmt not in ("bin", "itb", "both"):
              print(f"::error::不支援的 image_format: '{img_fmt}'（僅支援 bin / itb / both）！", file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          # --- 解析頂部 DEVICES_CONFIG ---
          def parse_device_entry(raw_line: str) -> dict:
              parts = [p.strip() for p in raw_line.split("|")]
              if len(parts) == 1:
                  ts = "mediatek/filogic"
                  prof = parts[0]
                  name = prof
                  spec = "ImmortalWrt 官方原生支援機型"
              else:
                  ts = parts[0]
                  prof = parts[1]
                  name = parts[2] if len(parts) >= 3 and parts[2] else prof
                  spec = parts[3] if len(parts) >= 4 and parts[3] else f"{ts} 原生支援機型"

              if "/" not in ts:
                  raise ValueError(f"無效的 target/subtarget '{ts}'，應為如 mediatek/filogic")
              target, subtarget = [x.strip() for x in ts.split("/", 1)]
              if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+', target) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+', subtarget):
                  raise ValueError(f"無效的 target/subtarget 字元: '{ts}'")
              if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+', prof):
                  raise ValueError(f"無效的 profile_id: '{prof}'")

              return {
                  "target": target,
                  "subtarget": subtarget,
                  "ts": f"{target}/{subtarget}",
                  "ts_slug": f"{target}-{subtarget}",
                  "profile": prof,
                  "name": name,
                  "spec": spec,
              }

          raw_cfg = os.environ.get("DEVICES_CONFIG", "")
          catalog = []
          seen_keys = set()
          for line_no, raw in enumerate(raw_cfg.splitlines(), 1):
              line = raw.strip()
              if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                  continue
              try:
                  entry = parse_device_entry(line)
              except ValueError as e:
                  print(f"::error::DEVICES_CONFIG 第 {line_no} 行格式錯誤: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
                  sys.exit(1)
              k = (entry["ts"], entry["profile"])
              if k not in seen_keys:
                  seen_keys.add(k)
                  catalog.append(entry)

          if not catalog:
              print("::error::DEVICES_CONFIG 不可為空，請至少配置一個支援機型！", file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          # --- 依 target_filter 篩選（支援 all、逗號/空白分隔之 profile_id 或臨時 target/subtarget|profile） ---
          tf = (target_filter or "all").strip()
          if not tf or tf.lower() == "all":
              selected = list(catalog)
          else:
              tokens = [t.strip() for t in re.split(r'[,\s]+', tf) if t.strip()]
              selected = []
              sel_keys = set()
              for tok in tokens:
                  matched = [d for d in catalog if d["profile"] == tok or f"{d['ts']}|{d['profile']}" == tok or f"{d['ts']}:{d['profile']}" == tok]
                  if matched:
                      for d in matched:
                          k = (d["ts"], d["profile"])
                          if k not in sel_keys:
                              sel_keys.add(k)
                              selected.append(d)
                  else:
                      # 允許手動臨時輸入未在 DEVICES_CONFIG 的 firmware-selector 機型 (target/subtarget|profile 或 profile)
                      normalized_tok = tok.replace(":", "|", 1) if (":" in tok and "|" not in tok) else tok
                      try:
                          ad_hoc = parse_device_entry(normalized_tok)
                      except ValueError as e:
                          print(f"::error::target_filter 項目 '{tok}' 格式無效: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
                          sys.exit(1)
                      k = (ad_hoc["ts"], ad_hoc["profile"])
                      if k not in sel_keys:
                          sel_keys.add(k)
                          selected.append(ad_hoc)

          if not selected:
              print(f"::error::依據 target_filter='{tf}' 未匹配到任何編譯機型！", file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          # --- 按 target/subtarget 分組建立並行矩陣 ---
          groups = {}
          group_order = []
          for d in selected:
              ts = d["ts"]
              if ts not in groups:
                  groups[ts] = []
                  group_order.append(ts)
              groups[ts].append(d)

          tc_matrix = []
          build_matrix = []
          dual_mode_filogic = {"cudy_tr3000-v1", "jdcloud_re-cp-03", "cmcc_rax3000m-emmc"}

          for ts in group_order:
              devs = groups[ts]
              t0 = devs[0]
              tc_matrix.append({
                  "target": t0["target"],
                  "subtarget": t0["subtarget"],
                  "ts": ts,
                  "ts_slug": t0["ts_slug"],
                  "sample_profile": t0["profile"],
              })
              prof_str = " ".join(d["profile"] for d in devs)
              # 僅 mediatek/filogic 且選 both 時拆為雙 Runner (bin + itb) 並行；其餘架構採單一原生格式並行
              if img_fmt == "both" and ts == "mediatek/filogic":
                  fmts = ["bin", "itb"]
              elif img_fmt == "both":
                  fmts = ["bin"]
              else:
                  fmts = [img_fmt]

              for fmt in fmts:
                  build_matrix.append({
                      "target": t0["target"],
                      "subtarget": t0["subtarget"],
                      "ts": ts,
                      "ts_slug": t0["ts_slug"],
                      "img_fmt": fmt,
                      "profiles": prof_str,
                      "has_dual_mode": any(d["profile"] in dual_mode_filogic for d in devs),
                  })

          profile_sig = ",".join(f"{d['ts']}:{d['profile']}" for d in selected)
          print(json.dumps({
              "devices": selected,
              "tc_matrix": tc_matrix,
              "build_matrix": build_matrix,
              "profile_sig": profile_sig,
          }, ensure_ascii=False))
          PYEOF
          )

          DEVICES_JSON=$(printf '%s' "$PARSED_META" | jq -c '.devices')
          TC_MATRIX_JSON=$(printf '%s' "$PARSED_META" | jq -c '.tc_matrix')
          BUILD_MATRIX_JSON=$(printf '%s' "$PARSED_META" | jq -c '.build_matrix')
          PROFILE_SIG=$(printf '%s' "$PARSED_META" | jq -r '.profile_sig')

          # 2. 查詢 ImmortalWrt 主線 Ref 與精準 Commit SHA
          SOURCE_REF=""
          RESOLVED_VER=""
          IMM_COMMIT=""

          case "$CHOICE" in
            latest-release-1|latest-release-2|latest-release-3)
              RANK="${CHOICE##*-}"
              echo "正在查詢 ImmortalWrt 官方倉庫最新前 3 個正式版 Tag..."
              REMOTE_TAGS=$(retry 3 git ls-remote --tags --sort=-v:refname \
                https://github.com/immortalwrt/immortalwrt.git 'refs/tags/v[0-9]*')
              TOP3_TAGS=$(printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_TAGS" \
                | awk -F'refs/tags/' '!/\^\{\}$/ && $2 ~ /^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/ { if (c < 3) { print $2; c++ } }')

              if [ -z "$TOP3_TAGS" ]; then
                echo "::error::無法從 ImmortalWrt 官方倉庫查詢到任何正式版 Tag！"
                exit 1
              fi

              echo "目前官方最新三個穩定正式版依序為："
              printf '%s\n' "$TOP3_TAGS" | nl -w2 -s'. '

              SOURCE_REF=$(printf '%s\n' "$TOP3_TAGS" | sed -n "${RANK}p")
              [ -n "$SOURCE_REF" ] || SOURCE_REF=$(printf '%s\n' "$TOP3_TAGS" | sed -n '1p')
              RESOLVED_VER="${SOURCE_REF#v}"
              IMM_COMMIT=$(printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_TAGS" | awk -v ref="refs/tags/${SOURCE_REF}" '
                $2 == ref "^{}" { deref=$1 }
                $2 == ref       { direct=$1 }
                END { print (deref != "" ? deref : direct) }
              ')
              ;;
            latest-snapshot)
              echo "正在查詢 ImmortalWrt 最新開發分支..."
              REMOTE_HEADS=$(retry 3 git ls-remote --heads --sort=-v:refname \
                https://github.com/immortalwrt/immortalwrt.git 'refs/heads/openwrt-[0-9]*')
              SOURCE_REF=$(printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_HEADS" \
                | awk -F'refs/heads/' '$2 ~ /^openwrt-[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/ { if (!found) { print $2; found=1 } }')
              [ -n "$SOURCE_REF" ] || SOURCE_REF="openwrt-25.12"
              RESOLVED_VER="${SOURCE_REF#openwrt-}-SNAPSHOT"
              IMM_COMMIT=$(printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_HEADS" | awk -v ref="refs/heads/${SOURCE_REF}" '$2 == ref { print $1; exit }')
              ;;
            *)
              SOURCE_REF="$CHOICE"
              RESOLVED_VER="${CHOICE#v}"
              IMM_COMMIT=$(retry 3 git ls-remote https://github.com/immortalwrt/immortalwrt.git "$SOURCE_REF" "refs/tags/${SOURCE_REF}^{}" \
                | awk 'END{print $1}' || true)
              ;;
          esac

          IMM_SHORT="${IMM_COMMIT:0:12}"
          [ -n "$IMM_SHORT" ] || IMM_SHORT="unknown"

          case "$VARIANT_FILTER" in
            all) VARIANTS="Std Pro"; NEED_PRO="true" ;;
            Std) VARIANTS="Std"; NEED_PRO="false" ;;
            Pro) VARIANTS="Pro"; NEED_PRO="true" ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::不支援的 variant_filter: ${VARIANT_FILTER}"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

          NEED_NIKKI="false"
          NEED_RTP2HTTPD="false"
          HAS_PRO_PLUGINS="false"
          if [ "$NEED_PRO" = "true" ]; then
            [ "$ENABLE_NIKKI" = "Y" ] && NEED_NIKKI="true"
            [ "$ENABLE_RTP2HTTPD" = "Y" ] && NEED_RTP2HTTPD="true"
            if [ "$NEED_NIKKI" = "true" ] || [ "$NEED_RTP2HTTPD" = "true" ]; then
              HAS_PRO_PLUGINS="true"
            fi
          fi

          # 3. 僅在開啟 AUTO_BUILD_TRACK_PLUGINS=Y 時才將插件納入上游變動指紋
          #    預設 N：完全不因 mihomo Alpha 核心頻繁更新而觸發額外自動編譯！
          mkdir -p /tmp/upstream_probe
          NIKKI_COMMIT="ignored"
          MIHOMO_VER="ignored"
          RTP_COMMIT="ignored"

          if [ "$TRACK_PLUGINS" = "Y" ]; then
            if [ "$NEED_NIKKI" = "true" ]; then
              (
                git ls-remote https://github.com/nikkinikki-org/OpenWrt-nikki.git refs/heads/main 2>/dev/null \
                  | awk 'NR==1{print substr($1,1,12)}' > /tmp/upstream_probe/nikki || true
              ) &
              PID_N=$!
              (
                curl -fsSL --retry 2 --connect-timeout 8 \
                  https://github.com/vernesong/mihomo/releases/download/Prerelease-Alpha/version.txt 2>/dev/null \
                  | tr -d '[:space:]' > /tmp/upstream_probe/mihomo || true
              ) &
              PID_M=$!
            fi
            if [ "$NEED_RTP2HTTPD" = "true" ]; then
              (
                git ls-remote https://github.com/stackia/rtp2httpd.git HEAD 2>/dev/null \
                  | awk 'NR==1{print substr($1,1,12)}' > /tmp/upstream_probe/rtp || true
              ) &
              PID_R=$!
            fi
            [ "$NEED_NIKKI" = "true" ] && { wait "$PID_N" || true; wait "$PID_M" || true; }
            [ "$NEED_RTP2HTTPD" = "true" ] && { wait "$PID_R" || true; }

            if [ "$NEED_NIKKI" = "true" ]; then
              NIKKI_COMMIT=$(cat /tmp/upstream_probe/nikki 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]' || true)
              [ -n "$NIKKI_COMMIT" ] || NIKKI_COMMIT="unknown"
              MIHOMO_VER=$(cat /tmp/upstream_probe/mihomo 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]' || true)
              [ -n "$MIHOMO_VER" ] || MIHOMO_VER="unknown"
            else
              NIKKI_COMMIT="disabled"
              MIHOMO_VER="disabled"
            fi
            if [ "$NEED_RTP2HTTPD" = "true" ]; then
              RTP_COMMIT=$(cat /tmp/upstream_probe/rtp 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]' || true)
              [ -n "$RTP_COMMIT" ] || RTP_COMMIT="unknown"
            else
              RTP_COMMIT="disabled"
            fi
          fi

          TRACK_SCOPE="${CHOICE}|${IMG_FMT}|${PROFILE_SIG}|${VARIANT_FILTER}"
          if [ "$TRACK_PLUGINS" = "Y" ]; then
            UPSTREAM_FINGERPRINT="scope=${TRACK_SCOPE};ref=${SOURCE_REF};imm=${IMM_SHORT};nikki=${NIKKI_COMMIT};rtp=${RTP_COMMIT};mihomo=${MIHOMO_VER}"
          else
            UPSTREAM_FINGERPRINT="scope=${TRACK_SCOPE};ref=${SOURCE_REF};imm=${IMM_SHORT}"
          fi

          # 4. 與前次同規格 GitHub Release 指紋比對，並整合「每月 1 日 00:00 例行自動編譯」判定
          RELEASES_JSON_FILE="/tmp/upstream_probe/releases.json"
          curl -fsSL --retry 2 --connect-timeout 10 \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO_FULL}/releases?per_page=30" \
            -o "$RELEASES_JSON_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo '[]' > "$RELEASES_JSON_FILE"

          DECISION_JSON=$(python3 - "$EVENT_NAME" "$IS_MONTHLY_TRIGGER" "$AUTO_ENABLED" "$MONTHLY_ENABLED" "$TRACK_SCOPE" "$UPSTREAM_FINGERPRINT" "$TAIPEI_YM" "$RELEASES_JSON_FILE" << 'PYEOF'
          import json
          import re
          import sys

          event_name, is_monthly, auto_enabled, monthly_enabled, track_scope, cur_fp, taipei_ym, rel_path = sys.argv[1:9]

          def parse_fp(fp: str) -> dict:
              out = {}
              for item in fp.split(";"):
                  if "=" in item:
                      k, v = item.split("=", 1)
                      out[k.strip()] = v.strip()
              return out

          last_fp = ""
          last_tag = ""
          try:
              with open(rel_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  releases = json.load(f)
              if isinstance(releases, list):
                  for rel in releases:
                      if rel.get("draft"):
                          continue
                      body = rel.get("body") or ""
                      m = re.search(r'<!--\s*UPSTREAM_FINGERPRINT:([^\n>]+?)\s*-->', body)
                      if not m:
                          continue
                      fp_candidate = m.group(1).strip()
                      parsed = parse_fp(fp_candidate)
                      if parsed.get("scope") == track_scope:
                          last_fp = fp_candidate
                          last_tag = rel.get("tag_name") or ""
                          break
          except Exception:
              pass

          cur_map = parse_fp(cur_fp)
          last_map = parse_fp(last_fp) if last_fp else {}

          diffs = []
          labels = {
              "ref": "ImmortalWrt 官方正式版",
              "imm": "ImmortalWrt 主線提交",
              "nikki": "Nikki 插件上游",
              "rtp": "rtp2httpd 插件上游",
              "mihomo": "mihomo Alpha-Smart 核心",
          }
          if last_map:
              for key in ("ref", "imm", "nikki", "rtp", "mihomo"):
                  if key in cur_map and cur_map.get(key) != last_map.get(key):
                      diffs.append(f"{labels[key]} ({last_map.get(key, '無')} -> {cur_map.get(key, '無')})")

          if event_name == "schedule":
              if is_monthly == "true":
                  if monthly_enabled != "Y":
                      res = {"should_build": "false", "reason": "MONTHLY_BUILD_ENABLED=N，已關閉每月 1 日定期編譯", "last_tag": last_tag}
                  else:
                      extra = ("；同步偵測到上游更新：" + "、".join(diffs)) if diffs else "（即時同步最新插件、核心與安全修補）"
                      res = {"should_build": "true", "reason": f"{taipei_ym}-01 00:00 每月例行自動編譯{extra}", "last_tag": last_tag}
              else:
                  if auto_enabled != "Y":
                      res = {"should_build": "false", "reason": "AUTO_BUILD_ENABLED=N，已關閉上游新版本自動巡檢", "last_tag": last_tag}
                  elif last_fp and cur_fp == last_fp:
                      res = {"should_build": "false", "reason": f"ImmortalWrt 上游無新正式版（與前次發佈 {last_tag} 一致，已略過編譯）", "last_tag": last_tag}
                  elif not last_fp:
                      res = {"should_build": "true", "reason": "首次建立此機型組合之自動編譯基準版本", "last_tag": ""}
                  else:
                      res = {"should_build": "true", "reason": "偵測到上游發佈更新：" + "；".join(diffs or ["指紋已更新"]), "last_tag": last_tag}
          else:
              if diffs:
                  reason = "手動觸發編譯（同步偵測到變動：" + "；".join(diffs) + "）"
              elif last_tag:
                  reason = f"手動觸發編譯（ImmortalWrt 主線與前次發佈 {last_tag} 一致）"
              else:
                  reason = "手動觸發編譯"
              res = {"should_build": "true", "reason": reason, "last_tag": last_tag}

          print(json.dumps(res, ensure_ascii=False))
          PYEOF
          )

          SHOULD_BUILD=$(printf '%s' "$DECISION_JSON" | jq -r '.should_build')
          CHANGE_REASON=$(printf '%s' "$DECISION_JSON" | jq -r '.reason')
          LAST_TAG=$(printf '%s' "$DECISION_JSON" | jq -r '.last_tag')

          echo "================================================================="
          echo "排程判定與上游巡檢結果："
          echo "  - 觸發來源         : ${TRIGGER_LABEL}"
          echo "  - 是否執行編譯     : ${SHOULD_BUILD}"
          echo "  - 判定原因         : ${CHANGE_REASON}"
          echo "  - 監測外部插件變動 : ${TRACK_PLUGINS} (預設 N：不因 mihomo Alpha 頻繁更新觸發)"
          echo "  - 當前上游指紋     : ${UPSTREAM_FINGERPRINT}"
          [ -n "$LAST_TAG" ] && echo "  - 前次同規格發佈   : ${LAST_TAG}"
          echo "================================================================="
          echo "已解析機型與並行矩陣："
          echo "  - Source Ref       : ${SOURCE_REF} (版本號: ${RESOLVED_VER}, Commit: ${IMM_SHORT})"
          echo "  - Image Format     : ${IMG_FMT} | Variants: ${VARIANTS}"
          echo "  - 機型列表         : ${PROFILE_SIG}"
          echo "  - Toolchain 矩陣   : ${TC_MATRIX_JSON}"
          echo "  - Build 並行矩陣   : ${BUILD_MATRIX_JSON}"
          echo "  - LAN / 主機 / 帳號: ${LAN_IP} / ${HOSTNAME_VAL} / ${LOGIN_USER} (密碼: $([ -n "$LOGIN_PASS" ] && echo "已設定" || echo "免密碼"))"

          if [ "$SHOULD_BUILD" != "true" ]; then
            {
              echo "### ⏭️ 上游巡檢完成 — 本次跳過編譯"
              echo "- **觸發來源**: ${TRIGGER_LABEL}"
              echo "- **判定結果**: ${CHANGE_REASON}"
              echo "- **目標版本**: \`${RESOLVED_VER}\` (\`${SOURCE_REF}\` @ \`${IMM_SHORT}\`)"
              echo "- **配置機型**: \`${PROFILE_SIG}\`"
              echo "- **當前指紋**: \`${UPSTREAM_FINGERPRINT}\`"
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

          {
            echo "should_build=${SHOULD_BUILD}"
            echo "trigger_label=${TRIGGER_LABEL}"
            echo "change_reason=${CHANGE_REASON}"
            echo "upstream_fingerprint=${UPSTREAM_FINGERPRINT}"
            echo "source_ref=${SOURCE_REF}"
            echo "resolved_ver=${RESOLVED_VER}"
            echo "img_fmt=${IMG_FMT}"
            echo "tc_matrix_json=${TC_MATRIX_JSON}"
            echo "build_matrix_json=${BUILD_MATRIX_JSON}"
            echo "devices_json=${DEVICES_JSON}"
            echo "variants=${VARIANTS}"
            echo "lan_ip=${LAN_IP}"
            echo "hostname=${HOSTNAME_VAL}"
            echo "login_user=${LOGIN_USER}"
            echo "login_pass=${LOGIN_PASS}"
            echo "need_pro=${NEED_PRO}"
            echo "need_nikki=${NEED_NIKKI}"
            echo "need_rtp2httpd=${NEED_RTP2HTTPD}"
            echo "has_pro_plugins=${HAS_PRO_PLUGINS}"
            echo "enable_nikki=${ENABLE_NIKKI}"
            echo "enable_rtp2httpd=${ENABLE_RTP2HTTPD}"
            echo "enable_argon=${ENABLE_ARGON}"
            echo "enable_ttyd=${ENABLE_TTYD}"
            echo "enable_sftp=${ENABLE_SFTP}"
            echo "enable_wwan=${ENABLE_WWAN}"
            echo "enable_bbr=${ENABLE_BBR}"
            echo "enable_tc_cache=${ENABLE_TC_CACHE}"
            echo "skip_unsupported=${SKIP_UNSUPPORTED}"
            echo "build_start_time=${BUILD_START_TIME}"
            echo "cache_week=${CACHE_WEEK}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  # ===========================================================================
  # 階段 2：按架構並行的預編譯工具鏈快取門控 (Per-Target Toolchain Cache Gate)
  # 快取命中時 lookup-only 約 10 秒通過；未命中時僅編譯一次 tools+toolchain
  # 供同架構所有機型與 BIN/ITB 並行 Runner 共享，單次直省 20~35 分鐘！
  # ===========================================================================
  toolchain:
    name: 工具鏈快取 (${{ matrix.ts }}・${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }})
    needs: prepare
    if: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.should_build == 'true' && needs.prepare.outputs.enable_tc_cache == 'Y' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.prepare.outputs.tc_matrix_json) }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    env:
      DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive
      SOURCE_REF: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source_ref }}
      RESOLVED_VER: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}
      TARGET_NAME: ${{ matrix.target }}
      SUBTARGET_NAME: ${{ matrix.subtarget }}
      TS_SLUG: ${{ matrix.ts_slug }}
      SAMPLE_PROFILE: ${{ matrix.sample_profile }}
    steps:
      - name: 拉取源碼並計算工具鏈確定性指紋 (Compute Toolchain Hash)
        id: tc_meta
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            rm -rf openwrt
            if git clone --depth 1 --single-branch -b "$SOURCE_REF" \
              https://github.com/immortalwrt/immortalwrt.git openwrt; then
              break
            fi
            [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ] && { echo "::error::拉取 ImmortalWrt 源碼失敗！"; exit 1; }
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done

          TC_HASH=$(git -C openwrt ls-tree HEAD tools toolchain include/toolchain-build.mk "target/linux/${TARGET_NAME}/Makefile" \
            | sha256sum | cut -c1-12)
          echo "計算完成 [${TARGET_NAME}/${SUBTARGET_NAME}] Toolchain 指紋: ${TC_HASH}"
          echo "tc_hash=${TC_HASH}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: 零下載檢查工具鏈快取是否已存在 (Lookup Toolchain Cache)
        id: tc_lookup
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v5
        with:
          path: |
            openwrt/staging_dir/host
            openwrt/staging_dir/toolchain-*
          key: toolchain-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-${{ steps.tc_meta.outputs.tc_hash }}
          lookup-only: true

      - name: 快取未命中 — 安裝精簡依賴並清理磁碟 (Init Env on Miss)
        if: ${{ steps.tc_lookup.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf '%s\n' \
            /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc \
            /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL /usr/local/share/boost /usr/local/share/swift \
            /usr/share/miniconda /usr/local/graalvm /usr/local/.ghcup \
            /usr/local/share/powershell /usr/local/share/chromium \
            /usr/local/lib/node_modules /opt/az \
            | xargs -P "$(nproc)" sudo rm -rf &
          CLEAN_PID=$!

          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/man-db/auto-update
          sudo -E apt-get -qq update
          sudo -E apt-get -qq -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 install -y --no-install-recommends \
            ack autoconf automake autopoint binutils bison build-essential bzip2 \
            ca-certificates ccache cmake cpio curl device-tree-compiler file flex \
            g++ g++-multilib gawk gcc gcc-multilib genisoimage gettext git gperf \
            intltool jq lib32gcc-s1 libc6-dev-i386 libdw-dev libelf-dev libfuse-dev \
            libglib2.0-dev libgmp-dev libltdl-dev libmbedtls-dev libmpc-dev \
            libmpfr-dev libncurses-dev libpython3-dev libreadline-dev libssl-dev \
            libtool libzstd-dev ninja-build openssl patch pkgconf python3 python3-pip \
            python3-ply python3-pyelftools python3-setuptools re2c rsync \
            squashfs-tools swig texinfo time u-boot-tools unzip wget xsltproc \
            xxd xz-utils zlib1g-dev zstd
          wait "$CLEAN_PID" || true
          sudo -E apt-get -qq clean

      - name: 載入 dl 源碼快取供工具鏈編譯使用 (Restore dl Cache)
        if: ${{ steps.tc_lookup.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' }}
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v5
        with:
          path: openwrt/dl
          key: dl-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.cache_week }}
          restore-keys: |
            dl-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-
            dl-tc-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-
            dl-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-

      - name: 預編譯 Host Tools 與 Cross-Toolchain (Build Tools & Toolchain)
        if: ${{ steps.tc_lookup.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' }}
        working-directory: ./openwrt
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BUILD_JOBS=$(( $(nproc) + 1 ))
          DL_JOBS=$(( $(nproc) * 2 ))

          cat > .config << EOF
          CONFIG_TARGET_${TARGET_NAME}=y
          CONFIG_TARGET_${TARGET_NAME}_${SUBTARGET_NAME}=y
          CONFIG_TARGET_ROOTFS_SQUASHFS=y
          # CONFIG_TARGET_ROOTFS_EXT4FS is not set
          # CONFIG_TARGET_ROOTFS_TARGZ is not set
          CONFIG_DEVEL=y
          CONFIG_CCACHE=y
          EOF
          make defconfig

          echo "::group::併發下載 Tools 與 Toolchain 源碼包 (-j${DL_JOBS})"
          make tools/download -j"${DL_JOBS}" || make tools/download -j4 V=s
          make toolchain/download -j"${DL_JOBS}" || make toolchain/download -j4 V=s
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "開始編譯 Host Tools (-j${BUILD_JOBS})..."
          make tools/install -j"${BUILD_JOBS}" || make tools/install -j"$(nproc)" || make tools/install -j1 V=s

          echo "開始編譯 Cross-Toolchain (-j${BUILD_JOBS})..."
          make toolchain/install -j"${BUILD_JOBS}" || make toolchain/install -j"$(nproc)" || make toolchain/install -j1 V=s

          TC_GCC=$(find staging_dir/toolchain-* -maxdepth 2 -path '*/bin/*-openwrt-linux-*-gcc' -type f | awk 'NR==1')
          if [ -z "$TC_GCC" ] || ! "$TC_GCC" --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::error::預編譯 Toolchain 校驗失敗！"
            exit 1
          fi
          "$TC_GCC" --version | awk 'NR==1'
          du -sh staging_dir/host staging_dir/toolchain-*

      - name: 儲存預編譯工具鏈快取 (Save Toolchain Cache)
        if: ${{ steps.tc_lookup.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' }}
        uses: actions/cache/save@v5
        with:
          path: |
            openwrt/staging_dir/host
            openwrt/staging_dir/toolchain-*
          key: toolchain-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-${{ steps.tc_meta.outputs.tc_hash }}

      - name: 儲存工具鏈 dl 備援快取 (Save Toolchain dl Cache)
        if: ${{ steps.tc_lookup.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' }}
        uses: actions/cache/save@v5
        with:
          path: openwrt/dl
          key: dl-tc-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.cache_week }}-${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: 輸出工具鏈快取狀態 (Report Toolchain Status)
        env:
          TC_LOOKUP_HIT: ${{ steps.tc_lookup.outputs.cache-hit || 'false' }}
          TC_HASH: ${{ steps.tc_meta.outputs.tc_hash || '' }}
        run: |
          if [ "$TC_LOOKUP_HIT" = "true" ]; then
            echo "[HIT] 工具鏈快取命中 (toolchain-${TS_SLUG}-${RESOLVED_VER}-${TC_HASH})，已略過 tools/toolchain 重編！"
          else
            echo "[BUILT] 工具鏈已編譯並寫入快取 (toolchain-${TS_SLUG}-${RESOLVED_VER}-${TC_HASH})"
          fi

  # ===========================================================================
  # 階段 3：跨架構 × 多格式矩陣並行 + Multi-Profile + 增量 Std->Pro 極速編譯
  # 1. 同架構全部機型（預設 4 款 Filogic）以 Multi-Profile 一次共用核心與套件編譯
  # 2. 跨架構機型或雙格式 (both) 自動啟動多台 GitHub Runner 並行編譯
  # 3. 預載工具鏈快取 + content-hash ccache + 多路併發初始化，極致壓縮編譯時間
  # ===========================================================================
  build:
    name: 極速編譯 (${{ matrix.ts }}・${{ matrix.img_fmt }}・${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }})
    needs: [prepare, toolchain]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' && needs.prepare.outputs.should_build == 'true' && (needs.toolchain.result == 'success' || needs.toolchain.result == 'skipped') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 300
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.prepare.outputs.build_matrix_json) }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    env:
      DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive
      RESOLVED_VER: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}
      SOURCE_REF: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source_ref }}
      TARGET_NAME: ${{ matrix.target }}
      SUBTARGET_NAME: ${{ matrix.subtarget }}
      TS_PAIR: ${{ matrix.ts }}
      TS_SLUG: ${{ matrix.ts_slug }}
      IMG_FMT: ${{ matrix.img_fmt }}
      IMG_FMT_MODE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.img_fmt }}
      TARGETS: ${{ matrix.profiles }}
      VARIANTS: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.variants }}
      LAN_IP: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.lan_ip }}
      HOSTNAME_VAL: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.hostname }}
      LOGIN_USER: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.login_user }}
      LOGIN_PASS: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.login_pass }}
      NEED_PRO: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.need_pro }}
      NEED_NIKKI: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.need_nikki }}
      NEED_RTP2HTTPD: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.need_rtp2httpd }}
      HAS_PRO_PLUGINS: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.has_pro_plugins }}
      ENABLE_NIKKI: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.enable_nikki }}
      ENABLE_RTP2HTTPD: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.enable_rtp2httpd }}
      ENABLE_ARGON: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.enable_argon }}
      ENABLE_TTYD: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.enable_ttyd }}
      ENABLE_SFTP: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.enable_sftp }}
      ENABLE_WWAN: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.enable_wwan }}
      ENABLE_BBR: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.enable_bbr }}
      ENABLE_TC_CACHE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.enable_tc_cache }}
      SKIP_UNSUPPORTED: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.skip_unsupported }}
      # ccache 極速調優：使用 content 檢查避免工具鏈還原時間戳變化導致快取失效！
      CCACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/openwrt/.ccache
      CCACHE_BASEDIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/openwrt
      CCACHE_COMPILERCHECK: "content"
      CCACHE_NOHASHDIR: "true"
      CCACHE_COMPRESS: "true"
      CCACHE_COMPRESSLEVEL: "6"
      CCACHE_MAXSIZE: "2G"
      CCACHE_SLOPPINESS: "file_macro,locale,time_macros,pch_defines"

    steps:
      - name: 併發環境初始化、拉取源碼與預取外部組件 (Parallel Fast Init & Pre-Fetch)
        id: clone
        env:
          BUILD_START_TIME: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.build_start_time }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/init_logs

          echo "::group::啟動多路併發初始化 (磁碟清理 || APT 依賴 || 源碼 Clone || 外部組件預取)"
          (
            printf '%s\n' \
              /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc \
              /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL /usr/local/share/boost /usr/local/share/swift \
              /usr/share/miniconda /usr/local/graalvm /usr/local/.ghcup \
              /usr/local/share/powershell /usr/local/share/chromium \
              /usr/local/lib/node_modules /opt/az \
              | xargs -P "$(nproc)" sudo rm -rf
          ) >/tmp/init_logs/clean.log 2>&1 &
          PID_CLEAN=$!

          (
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              rm -rf openwrt
              if git clone --depth 1 --single-branch -b "$SOURCE_REF" \
                https://github.com/immortalwrt/immortalwrt.git openwrt; then
                exit 0
              fi
              [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ] && exit 1
              sleep $((attempt * 5))
            done
          ) >/tmp/init_logs/clone.log 2>&1 &
          PID_CLONE=$!

          PID_RTP=""
          if [ "$NEED_RTP2HTTPD" = "true" ]; then
            (
              rm -rf /tmp/rtp2httpd
              for attempt in 1 2 3; do
                if git clone --depth 1 --single-branch https://github.com/stackia/rtp2httpd.git /tmp/rtp2httpd; then
                  exit 0
                fi
                rm -rf /tmp/rtp2httpd
                [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ] && exit 1
                sleep $((attempt * 4))
              done
            ) >/tmp/init_logs/rtp.log 2>&1 &
            PID_RTP=$!
          fi

          PID_UPX=""
          if [ "$NEED_NIKKI" = "true" ]; then
            (
              UPX_VER="4.2.4"
              if curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
                "https://github.com/upx/upx/releases/download/v${UPX_VER}/upx-${UPX_VER}-amd64_linux.tar.xz" \
                -o /tmp/upx.tar.xz; then
                tar -Jxf /tmp/upx.tar.xz -C /tmp
                sudo install -m 0755 "/tmp/upx-${UPX_VER}-amd64_linux/upx" /usr/local/bin/upx
                rm -rf /tmp/upx*
                upx --version | awk 'NR==1'
              else
                echo "::warning::UPX 下載失敗，Nikki 預置的 mihomo 核心將保留未壓縮原檔"
              fi
            ) >/tmp/init_logs/upx.log 2>&1 &
            PID_UPX=$!
          fi

          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/man-db/auto-update
          sudo -E apt-get -qq update
          sudo -E apt-get -qq -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 install -y --no-install-recommends \
            ack autoconf automake autopoint binutils bison build-essential bzip2 \
            ca-certificates ccache cmake cpio curl device-tree-compiler file flex \
            g++ g++-multilib gawk gcc gcc-multilib genisoimage gettext git gperf \
            intltool jq lib32gcc-s1 libc6-dev-i386 libdw-dev libelf-dev libfuse-dev \
            libglib2.0-dev libgmp-dev libltdl-dev libmbedtls-dev libmpc-dev \
            libmpfr-dev libncurses-dev libpython3-dev libreadline-dev libssl-dev \
            libtool libzstd-dev ninja-build openssl patch pkgconf python3 python3-pip \
            python3-ply python3-pyelftools python3-setuptools re2c rsync \
            squashfs-tools swig texinfo time u-boot-tools unzip wget xsltproc \
            xxd xz-utils zlib1g-dev zstd

          sudo -E apt-get -qq clean
          sudo timedatectl set-timezone "Asia/Taipei"

          wait "$PID_CLEAN" || echo "::warning::部分磁碟清理失敗，繼續執行"
          wait "$PID_CLONE" || { cat /tmp/init_logs/clone.log; echo "::error::拉取 ImmortalWrt 源碼失敗！"; exit 1; }
          if [ -n "$PID_RTP" ]; then
            wait "$PID_RTP" || { cat /tmp/init_logs/rtp.log; echo "::error::預拉取 rtp2httpd 源碼失敗！"; exit 1; }
          fi
          if [ -n "$PID_UPX" ]; then
            wait "$PID_UPX" || cat /tmp/init_logs/upx.log
          fi

          TC_HASH=$(git -C openwrt ls-tree HEAD tools toolchain include/toolchain-build.mk "target/linux/${TARGET_NAME}/Makefile" \
            | sha256sum | cut -c1-12)

          UPSTREAM_COMMIT_UNIX=$(git -C openwrt log -1 --format="%ct" 2>/dev/null || true)
          UPSTREAM_COMMIT_HASH=$(git -C openwrt log -1 --format="%h" 2>/dev/null || echo "latest")
          if [ -n "$UPSTREAM_COMMIT_UNIX" ]; then
            UPSTREAM_COMMIT_TIME=$(TZ=Asia/Taipei date -d "@${UPSTREAM_COMMIT_UNIX}" "+%Y年%m月%d日 %H時%M分")
          else
            UPSTREAM_COMMIT_TIME="${BUILD_START_TIME}"
          fi

          echo "已併發完成初始化 | ${TS_PAIR} | ${SOURCE_REF} @ ${UPSTREAM_COMMIT_HASH} | TC_HASH=${TC_HASH}"
          df -hT /
          echo "::endgroup::"

          {
            echo "tc_hash=${TC_HASH}"
            echo "upstream_commit_time=${UPSTREAM_COMMIT_TIME}"
            echo "upstream_commit_hash=${UPSTREAM_COMMIT_HASH}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: 載入預編譯工具鏈快取 (Restore Prebuilt Toolchain Cache)
        if: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.enable_tc_cache == 'Y' }}
        id: restore_tc
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v5
        with:
          path: |
            openwrt/staging_dir/host
            openwrt/staging_dir/toolchain-*
          key: toolchain-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-${{ steps.clone.outputs.tc_hash }}

      - name: 載入 dl 源碼包週級快取 (Restore dl Cache)
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: openwrt/dl
          key: dl-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.cache_week }}
          restore-keys: |
            dl-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-
            dl-tc-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-
            dl-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-

      - name: 載入統一 ccache 編譯快取 (Restore Unified ccache)
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: openwrt/.ccache
          key: ccache-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-${{ matrix.img_fmt }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          restore-keys: |
            ccache-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-${{ matrix.img_fmt }}-
            ccache-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.resolved_ver }}-
            ccache-${{ matrix.ts_slug }}-

      - name: 按需適配設備硬體與原生格式規則 (Modular Device Adaptation)
        working-directory: ./openwrt
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$TS_PAIR" != "mediatek/filogic" ]; then
            echo "[OK][${TS_PAIR}] 採用 ImmortalWrt 上游原生硬體與映像配方，無需特殊分區補丁。"
            exit 0
          fi

          python3 - "$IMG_FMT" "$TARGETS" << 'PYEOF'
          import glob
          import os
          import re
          import sys

          img_fmt = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "bin"
          active_devs = set(sys.argv[2].split()) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else set()

          has_cudy = "cudy_tr3000-v1" in active_devs
          has_rax = "cmcc_rax3000m-emmc" in active_devs
          has_jd = "jdcloud_re-cp-03" in active_devs
          has_emmc_yuzhii = has_rax or has_jd
          other_devs = sorted(active_devs - {"cudy_tr3000-v1", "cmcc_rax3000m-emmc", "jdcloud_re-cp-03"})

          print(f"=== [mediatek/filogic] 原生 [{img_fmt.upper()}] 適配 | 本批機型: {sorted(active_devs)} ===")
          if other_devs:
              print(f"[OK][上游原生] 以下機型完整保留 ImmortalWrt 官方原生硬體與分區定義: {other_devs}")

          # 1. Cudy TR3000 v1 (128MB SPI-NAND 112MB 大分區擴展)
          if has_cudy:
              cudy_dts_patched = False
              for dts_file in glob.glob("target/linux/mediatek/dts/*cudy-tr3000-v1*.dts*"):
                  with open(dts_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                      s = f.read()
                  new_s, n = re.subn(
                      r'reg\s*=\s*<0x0*5c0000\s+0x0*4000000>;',
                      'reg = <0x5c0000 0x7000000>;',
                      s
                  )
                  if n > 0:
                      with open(dts_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                          f.write(new_s)
                      cudy_dts_patched = True
                      print(f"[OK][cudy_tr3000-v1] 已將 {dts_file} 的 ubi 分區擴展為 112M (0x7000000)")
                  elif "0x7000000" in s:
                      cudy_dts_patched = True
                      print(f"[OK][cudy_tr3000-v1] {dts_file} 已為 112M 分區")
              if not cudy_dts_patched:
                  print("::warning::未在 cudy-tr3000-v1 DTS 偵測到 0x4000000 分區定義，請確認上游是否已變更分區表")

          if img_fmt == "itb":
              if has_cudy:
                  has_cudy_ubootmod = False
                  for mk_path in glob.glob("target/linux/mediatek/image/*.mk"):
                      with open(mk_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                          if re.search(r'^define\s+Device/cudy_tr3000-v1-ubootmod\b', f.read(), flags=re.M):
                              has_cudy_ubootmod = True
                              break
                  if has_cudy_ubootmod:
                      print("[OK][ITB 模式] 偵測到官方原生 Device/cudy_tr3000-v1-ubootmod，採用上游原生 FIT (.itb) 配方")
                  else:
                      patched_any = False
                      for mk_path in glob.glob("target/linux/mediatek/image/*.mk"):
                          with open(mk_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                              raw_lines = f.read().splitlines()
                          out_lines = []
                          in_cudy = False
                          patched = False
                          for line in raw_lines:
                              stripped = line.strip()
                              if re.match(r'^define\s+Device/cudy_tr3000-v1\b', stripped):
                                  in_cudy = True
                                  out_lines.append(line)
                                  continue
                              if in_cudy:
                                  if stripped == "endef":
                                      out_lines.extend([
                                          "  KERNEL := kernel-bin | gzip",
                                          "  KERNEL_INITRAMFS := kernel-bin | lzma | fit lzma $$(KDIR)/image-$$(firstword $$(DEVICE_DTS)).dtb with-initrd | pad-to 64k",
                                          "  KERNEL_INITRAMFS_SUFFIX := -recovery.itb",
                                          "  IMAGES := sysupgrade.itb",
                                          "  IMAGE_SIZE := 114688k",
                                          "  IMAGE/sysupgrade.itb := append-kernel | fit gzip $$(KDIR)/image-$$(firstword $$(DEVICE_DTS)).dtb external-static-with-rootfs | pad-rootfs | append-metadata",
                                          line,
                                      ])
                                      in_cudy = False
                                      patched = True
                                      continue
                                  if any(stripped.startswith(k) for k in ("IMAGES", "IMAGE/", "IMAGE_SIZE", "KERNEL")):
                                      continue
                              out_lines.append(line)
                          if patched:
                              with open(mk_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                                  f.write("\n".join(out_lines) + "\n")
                              patched_any = True
                              print(f"[OK][ITB 模式] 已於 {mk_path} 為 cudy_tr3000-v1 啟用原生 FIT (.itb) 編譯規則")
                      if not patched_any:
                          print("::error::[ITB 模式] 無法找到 cudy_tr3000-v1 設備定義！", file=sys.stderr)
                          sys.exit(1)
              sys.exit(0)

          # =========================================================================
          # 【原生 BIN 模式】：僅對啟用的 Yuzhii U-Boot 專屬機型套用適配，完全不干擾 GL-MT3600BE 等其他機型
          # =========================================================================
          if not (has_cudy or has_emmc_yuzhii):
              print("[OK][BIN 模式] 本批無需 Yuzhii U-Boot 專屬補丁，全部採用官方原生配置。")
              sys.exit(0)

          def extract_dtso_to_dts(dtso_text: str) -> str:
              dtso_text = re.sub(r'^\s*rootdisk\s*=\s*<&[^>]+>;\s*\n?', '', dtso_text, flags=re.M)
              if "fragment@" not in dtso_text:
                  cleaned = re.sub(r'^\s*/(dts-v1|plugin)/;\s*\n?', '', dtso_text, flags=re.M)
                  cleaned = re.sub(r'/\s*\{\s*compatible\s*=\s*[^;]+;\s*\};\s*', '', cleaned, flags=re.S)
                  return "\n" + cleaned.strip() + "\n"
              out = []
              pos = 0
              while True:
                  m = re.search(r'fragment@\d+\s*\{', dtso_text[pos:])
                  if not m:
                      break
                  start = pos + m.end()
                  depth = 1
                  i = start
                  while i < len(dtso_text) and depth > 0:
                      if dtso_text[i] == '{':
                          depth += 1
                      elif dtso_text[i] == '}':
                          depth -= 1
                      i += 1
                  frag_body = dtso_text[start:i - 1]
                  pos = i
                  t_m = re.search(r'target\s*=\s*<(&[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)>;', frag_body)
                  tp_m = re.search(r'target-path\s*=\s*"([^"]+)";', frag_body)
                  o_m = re.search(r'__overlay__\s*\{', frag_body)
                  if o_m:
                      o_start = o_m.end()
                      o_depth = 1
                      j = o_start
                      while j < len(frag_body) and o_depth > 0:
                          if frag_body[j] == '{':
                              o_depth += 1
                          elif frag_body[j] == '}':
                              o_depth -= 1
                          j += 1
                      overlay_body = frag_body[o_start:j - 1]
                      if not overlay_body.strip():
                          continue
                      if t_m and t_m.group(1) != "&chosen":
                          out.append(f"\n{t_m.group(1)} {{{overlay_body}}};\n")
                      elif (t_m and t_m.group(1) == "&chosen") or (tp_m and tp_m.group(1) == "/chosen"):
                          out.append(f"\n/ {{\n\tchosen {{{overlay_body}}};\n}};\n")
                      elif tp_m and tp_m.group(1) == "/":
                          out.append(f"\n/ {{{overlay_body}}};\n")
              return "".join(out)

          rax_dts = "target/linux/mediatek/dts/mt7981b-cmcc-rax3000m.dts"
          rax_dtso = "target/linux/mediatek/dts/mt7981b-cmcc-rax3000m-emmc.dtso"
          if has_rax and os.path.exists(rax_dts) and os.path.exists(rax_dtso):
              with open(rax_dts, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  dts_content = f.read()
              with open(rax_dtso, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  dtso_content = f.read()
              if "&mmc0" not in dts_content and ("fragment@" in dtso_content or "&mmc0" in dtso_content):
                  merged_nodes = extract_dtso_to_dts(dtso_content)
                  dts_content = (
                      dts_content
                      + "\n/* Merged from mt7981b-cmcc-rax3000m-emmc.dtso for Yuzhii bl-mt798x-dhcpd */\n"
                      + merged_nodes
                  )
                  with open(rax_dts, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                      f.write(dts_content)
                  print(f"[OK][cmcc_rax3000m-emmc] 已將 {rax_dtso} 的 &mmc0 節點合併至 {rax_dts}")

          bootargs_line = 'bootargs = "console=ttyS0,115200n1 loglevel=8 earlycon=uart8250,mmio32,0x11002000 root=PARTLABEL=rootfs rootwait";'
          emmc_dts_targets = []
          if has_rax:
              emmc_dts_targets.append(rax_dts)
          if has_jd:
              emmc_dts_targets.append("target/linux/mediatek/dts/mt7986a-jdcloud-re-cp-03.dts")

          for emmc_dts in emmc_dts_targets:
              if os.path.exists(emmc_dts):
                  with open(emmc_dts, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                      s = f.read()
                  s = s.replace('block-partition-production', 'block-partition-rootfs')
                  s = s.replace('partname = "production"', 'partname = "rootfs"')
                  s = re.sub(r'^\s*rootdisk\s*=\s*<&[^>]+>;\s*\n?', '', s, flags=re.M)
                  s = re.sub(r'^\s*bootargs(-override|-append)?\s*=\s*"[^"]*";\s*\n?', '', s, flags=re.M)
                  s, n = re.subn(r'(chosen\s*\{)', rf'\1\n\t\t{bootargs_line}', s, count=1)
                  if n == 0:
                      s += f"\n/ {{\n\tchosen {{\n\t\t{bootargs_line}\n\t}};\n}};\n"
                  with open(emmc_dts, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                      f.write(s)
                  print(f"[OK][eMMC DTS] 已修正 {emmc_dts} 掛載分區為 root=PARTLABEL=rootfs")

          SKIP_KEYS = (
              "DEVICE_DTS_OVERLAY", "DEVICE_DTS_LOADADDR", "KERNEL",
              "KERNEL_INITRAMFS", "KERNEL_INITRAMFS_SUFFIX", "IMAGES",
              "IMAGE_SIZE", "IMAGE/sysupgrade.itb", "IMAGE/sysupgrade.bin",
              "ARTIFACTS", "ARTIFACT/", "COMPAT_VERSION", "COMPAT_MESSAGE",
              "UBOOTENV_IN_UBI", "KERNEL_IN_UBI",
          )

          total_patched = []
          for mk_path in glob.glob("target/linux/mediatek/image/*.mk"):
              with open(mk_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  raw_lines = f.read().splitlines()

              out_lines = []
              in_mode = None
              dev_name = ""
              skip_cont = False
              patched_in_file = []

              for line in raw_lines:
                  stripped = line.strip()
                  m_def = re.match(r'^define\s+Device/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)', stripped)
                  if m_def and in_mode is None:
                      dname = m_def.group(1)
                      if has_cudy and dname == "cudy_tr3000-v1":
                          in_mode = "cudy"
                          dev_name = dname
                          out_lines.append(line)
                          continue
                      elif (has_rax and dname.startswith("cmcc_rax3000m")) or (has_jd and dname.startswith("jdcloud_re-cp-03")):
                          in_mode = "emmc"
                          dev_name = dname
                          skip_cont = False
                          out_lines.append(line)
                          continue

                  if in_mode == "cudy":
                      if stripped == "endef":
                          in_mode = None
                          patched_in_file.append(dev_name)
                          out_lines.append(line)
                          continue
                      line = re.sub(r'IMAGE_SIZE\s*[:+]?=\s*65536k', 'IMAGE_SIZE := 114688k', line)
                      line = line.replace("sysupgrade-tar", "append-ubi | check-size")
                      out_lines.append(line)
                      continue

                  if in_mode == "emmc":
                      if stripped == "endef":
                          out_lines.extend([
                              "  DEVICE_DTS_OVERLAY :=",
                              "  KERNEL_IN_UBI :=",
                              "  UBOOTENV_IN_UBI :=",
                              "  ARTIFACTS :=",
                              "  KERNEL := kernel-bin | lzma | fit lzma $$(KDIR)/image-$$(firstword $$(DEVICE_DTS)).dtb",
                              "  KERNEL_INITRAMFS := kernel-bin | lzma | fit lzma $$(KDIR)/image-$$(firstword $$(DEVICE_DTS)).dtb with-initrd | pad-to 64k",
                              "  KERNEL_INITRAMFS_SUFFIX := -kernel.bin",
                              "  IMAGES := sysupgrade.bin",
                              "  IMAGE/sysupgrade.bin := sysupgrade-tar | append-metadata",
                              line,
                          ])
                          in_mode = None
                          skip_cont = False
                          patched_in_file.append(dev_name)
                          continue

                      if skip_cont:
                          if not stripped.endswith("\\"):
                              skip_cont = False
                          continue

                      tokens = stripped.split()
                      first_tok = tokens[0] if tokens else ""
                      if any(first_tok == k or first_tok.startswith("ARTIFACT/") for k in SKIP_KEYS):
                          if stripped.endswith("\\"):
                              skip_cont = True
                          continue

                      out_lines.append(line)
                      continue

                  out_lines.append(line)

              if patched_in_file:
                  with open(mk_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                      f.write("\n".join(out_lines) + "\n")
                  total_patched.extend(patched_in_file)
                  print(f"[OK][BIN 模式] 已於 {mk_path} 覆寫設備區塊: {patched_in_file}")

          required_special = []
          if has_cudy: required_special.append("cudy_tr3000-v1")
          if has_jd: required_special.append("jdcloud_re-cp-03")
          if has_rax: required_special.append("cmcc_rax3000m")
          for req in required_special:
              if not any(p.startswith(req) for p in total_patched):
                  print(f"::error::[BIN 模式] 未能在 *.mk 中找到並適配設備: {req}！已匹配: {total_patched}", file=sys.stderr)
                  sys.exit(1)

          if has_emmc_yuzhii:
              plat_sh = "target/linux/mediatek/filogic/base-files/lib/upgrade/platform.sh"
              if os.path.exists(plat_sh):
                  with open(plat_sh, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                      ps = f.read()
                  ps = re.sub(r'^\s*(cmcc,rax3000m|jdcloud,re-cp-03)\|\\\n', '', ps, flags=re.M)
                  ps = ps.replace('CI_KERNPART="production"', 'CI_KERNPART="kernel"\n\t\tCI_ROOTPART="rootfs"')

                  ps, n1 = re.subn(
                      r'^([ \t]*)(acer,predator-w6\|\\\n)',
                      r'\1cmcc,rax3000m|\\\n\1jdcloud,re-cp-03|\\\n\1\2',
                      ps,
                      count=1,
                      flags=re.M
                  )
                  if n1 == 0:
                      ps, n1 = re.subn(
                          r'(\t[^\n]+\)\n\t\tCI_KERNPART="kernel")',
                          r'\tcmcc,rax3000m|\\\n\tjdcloud,re-cp-03|\\\n\1',
                          ps,
                          count=1
                      )

                  ps, n2 = re.subn(
                      r'(\t[^\n]+\|\\\n\t[^\n]+\)\n\t\temmc_copy_config)',
                      r'\tcmcc,rax3000m|\\\n\tjdcloud,re-cp-03|\\\n\1',
                      ps,
                      count=1
                  )
                  if n2 == 0:
                      ps, n2 = re.subn(
                          r'(\t[^\n]+\)\n\t\temmc_copy_config)',
                          r'\tcmcc,rax3000m|\\\n\tjdcloud,re-cp-03|\\\n\1',
                          ps,
                          count=1
                      )

                  if 'nand_do_platform_check' in ps:
                      ps = re.sub(
                          r'(\*\)\n\t\tnand_do_platform_check)',
                          r'\tcmcc,rax3000m|\\\n\tjdcloud,re-cp-03)\n\t\treturn 0\n\t\t;;\n\t\1',
                          ps,
                          count=1
                      )

                  if n1 == 0 or n2 == 0:
                      print(f"::error::platform.sh 結構已變更 (n1={n1}, n2={n2})，中止編譯以防升級邏輯異常！", file=sys.stderr)
                      sys.exit(1)
                  with open(plat_sh, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                      f.write(ps)
                  print("[OK][BIN 模式] platform.sh eMMC kernel/rootfs 升級邏輯修正完成")

              for bf in [
                  "target/linux/mediatek/filogic/base-files/etc/board.d/02_network",
                  "target/linux/mediatek/filogic/base-files/etc/hotplug.d/firmware/11-mt76-caldata",
                  "target/linux/mediatek/filogic/base-files/etc/hotplug.d/ieee80211/11_fix_wifi_mac",
                  "package/boot/uboot-envtools/files/mediatek_filogic",
                  plat_sh,
              ]:
                  if os.path.exists(bf):
                      with open(bf, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                          c = f.read()
                      if "/dev/mmc*)" in c:
                          c = c.replace("/dev/mmc*)", '/dev/mmc*|PARTLABEL=*|"")')
                          with open(bf, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                              f.write(c)
                          print(f"[OK][base-files] 已擴展 {bf} 支援 root=PARTLABEL=rootfs")
          PYEOF

      - name: 更新軟體源並依模組開關整合外部插件 (Update Feeds & Modular Plugins)
        working-directory: ./openwrt
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          retry() {
            local max_attempts=$1; shift
            local attempt=1
            until "$@"; do
              [ "$attempt" -ge "$max_attempts" ] && return 1
              echo "::warning::指令失敗 (第 ${attempt}/${max_attempts} 次)，重試中..."
              sleep $((attempt * 4))
              attempt=$((attempt + 1))
            done
          }

          mod_nikki_pre_feed() {
            echo "[模組][Nikki] 註冊 OpenWrt-nikki 軟體源..."
            echo "src-git nikki https://github.com/nikkinikki-org/OpenWrt-nikki.git;main" >> feeds.conf.default
          }

          mod_nikki_post_feed() {
            echo "[模組][Nikki] 安裝 nikki feed、移除原版 mihomo 依賴並套用 rstrip.sh 白名單..."
            ./scripts/feeds install -a -f -p nikki

            for mk in feeds/nikki/nikki/Makefile package/feeds/nikki/nikki/Makefile; do
              if [ -f "$mk" ]; then
                sed -i -E 's/\+mihomo(-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)?([[:space:]]|\\|$)/\2/g' "$mk"
              fi
            done

            if [ -f scripts/rstrip.sh ]; then
              python3 - << 'PYEOF'
          import re
          import sys

          path = "scripts/rstrip.sh"
          with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              content = f.read()

          if "mihomo*" in content:
              print("[OK] scripts/rstrip.sh 已包含 mihomo* 白名單規則")
              sys.exit(0)

          new_content, n = re.subn(
              r'(find\s+"?\$\{?TARGETS\}?"?(?:[^\n]|\\\n)*?\s-type\s+f)\b',
              r'\1 ! -name "mihomo*"',
              content,
          )

          if n == 0:
              new_content, n = re.subn(
                  r'(while\s+read(?:\s+-r)?\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\b[^\n]*(?:;\s*|\n\s*)do\n)',
                  r'\1\t\tcase "${\2}" in *mihomo*) echo "$SELF: ${\2}: skipped (mihomo* whitelist)"; continue ;; esac\n',
                  content,
              )

          if n == 0:
              print("::error::scripts/rstrip.sh 白名單規則套用失敗！以下為相關行號供排查：", file=sys.stderr)
              for idx, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), 1):
                  if any(k in line for k in ("find", "TARGETS", "while", "read")):
                      print(f"  L{idx}: {line}", file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              f.write(new_content)

          print(f"[OK] 已於 {path} 成功套用 mihomo* 白名單規則 (更新 {n} 處)")
          PYEOF
            fi
          }

          mod_rtp2httpd_setup() {
            echo "[模組][rtp2httpd] 清理舊版並引入官方最新原生 C 版 (優先使用併發預拉取副本)..."
            rm -rf \
              feeds/packages/net/rtp2httpd \
              feeds/luci/applications/luci-app-rtp2httpd \
              package/feeds/packages/rtp2httpd \
              package/feeds/luci/luci-app-rtp2httpd \
              package/rtp2httpd \
              package/luci-app-rtp2httpd

            if [ ! -d /tmp/rtp2httpd/openwrt-support/rtp2httpd ]; then
              rm -rf /tmp/rtp2httpd
              retry 3 git clone --depth 1 --single-branch https://github.com/stackia/rtp2httpd.git /tmp/rtp2httpd
            fi
            cp -rf /tmp/rtp2httpd/openwrt-support/rtp2httpd package/rtp2httpd
            cp -rf /tmp/rtp2httpd/openwrt-support/luci-app-rtp2httpd package/luci-app-rtp2httpd
            [ -f package/rtp2httpd/Makefile.versioned ] && mv -f package/rtp2httpd/Makefile.versioned package/rtp2httpd/Makefile
            [ -f package/luci-app-rtp2httpd/Makefile.versioned ] && mv -f package/luci-app-rtp2httpd/Makefile.versioned package/luci-app-rtp2httpd/Makefile
            rm -rf /tmp/rtp2httpd
          }

          mod_argon_setup() {
            echo "[模組][Argon] 將 LuCI 集合預設主題由 bootstrap 替換為 Argon..."
            find feeds/luci/collections/ -name "Makefile" -exec sed -i 's/luci-theme-bootstrap/luci-theme-argon/g' {} + || true
          }

          echo "::group::更新並安裝 Feeds 與啟用之插件模組"
          [ "$NEED_NIKKI" = "true" ] && mod_nikki_pre_feed

          retry 3 ./scripts/feeds update -a
          ./scripts/feeds install -a

          [ "$NEED_NIKKI" = "true" ] && mod_nikki_post_feed
          [ "$NEED_RTP2HTTPD" = "true" ] && mod_rtp2httpd_setup
          [ "$ENABLE_ARGON" = "Y" ] && mod_argon_setup
          echo "::endgroup::"

      - name: 配置品牌標識、LAN IP、登入憑證、TCP BBR 與官方 kmods (Configure Branding, Network, Auth & Vermagic)
        working-directory: ./openwrt
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TARGET_VER="${RESOLVED_VER}"

          mod_network_branding_setup() {
            echo "[模組][網路與主機名] 套用預設 LAN IP: ${LAN_IP} | 主機名: ${HOSTNAME_VAL}"
            for cfg in \
              package/base-files/files/bin/config_generate \
              package/base-files/luci2/bin/config_generate \
              package/base-files/files/lib/preinit/00_preinit.conf; do
              if [ -f "$cfg" ]; then
                sed -i "s/192\.168\.1\.1/${LAN_IP}/g" "$cfg"
                sed -i "s/hostname='OpenWrt'/hostname='${HOSTNAME_VAL}'/g; s/hostname=\"OpenWrt\"/hostname=\"${HOSTNAME_VAL}\"/g" "$cfg"
              fi
            done
          }

          LOGIN_PASS_HASH=""
          mod_login_auth_prepare() {
            if [ -n "$LOGIN_PASS" ]; then
              LOGIN_PASS_HASH=$(printf '%s\n' "$LOGIN_PASS" | openssl passwd -6 -stdin)
              if [[ "$LOGIN_PASS_HASH" != \$6\$* ]] || [[ "$LOGIN_PASS_HASH" == *:* ]] || [[ "$LOGIN_PASS_HASH" == *\'* ]]; then
                echo "::error::無法產生合法的 SHA-512 密碼雜湊！"
                exit 1
              fi
              echo "[模組][登入憑證] 帳號: ${LOGIN_USER} | 密碼: 已產生 SHA-512 雜湊"
            else
              echo "[模組][登入憑證] 帳號: ${LOGIN_USER} | 密碼: 預設免密碼"
            fi
          }

          mod_network_branding_setup
          mod_login_auth_prepare

          if [ -f include/version.mk ]; then
            sed -i -E \
              -e 's/VERSION_DIST:=OpenWrt/VERSION_DIST:=ImmortalWrt/g' \
              -e 's/VERSION_DIST\),OpenWrt/VERSION_DIST),ImmortalWrt/g' \
              -e "s/VERSION_NUMBER:=[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-SNAPSHOT/VERSION_NUMBER:=${TARGET_VER}/g" \
              -e "s/VERSION_NUMBER\),[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-SNAPSHOT/VERSION_NUMBER),${TARGET_VER}/g" \
              include/version.mk
          fi
          for icfg in package/base-files/image-config.in Config.in; do
            if [ -f "$icfg" ]; then
              sed -i -E \
                -e 's/default "OpenWrt"/default "ImmortalWrt"/g' \
                -e "s/default \"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-SNAPSHOT\"/default \"${TARGET_VER}\"/g" \
                "$icfg"
            fi
          done

          # 動態依 TARGET_NAME/SUBTARGET_NAME 對齊官方 kmods vermagic
          KMAJOR=$(awk -F':=' '/^KERNEL_PATCHVER/{gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",$2); print $2; exit}' "target/linux/${TARGET_NAME}/Makefile" 2>/dev/null || true)
          KMINOR=""
          if [ -n "$KMAJOR" ] && [ -f "include/kernel-${KMAJOR}" ]; then
            KMINOR=$(awk -F'=' -v km="$KMAJOR" '$1 ~ "LINUX_VERSION-"km {gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",$2); print $2; exit}' "include/kernel-${KMAJOR}" 2>/dev/null || true)
          fi
          FULL_KVER="${KMAJOR}${KMINOR}"
          echo "偵測到 [${TS_PAIR}] 源碼樹核心版本: ${FULL_KVER:-未知} (主系列: ${KMAJOR:-未知})"

          OFFICIAL_KMOD_DIR=""
          OFFICIAL_VERMAGIC=""
          KMOD_CANDIDATE_URLS=("https://downloads.immortalwrt.org/releases/${TARGET_VER}/targets/${TARGET_NAME}/${SUBTARGET_NAME}/kmods/")
          if [[ "$TARGET_VER" == *SNAPSHOT* ]]; then
            KMOD_CANDIDATE_URLS+=("https://downloads.immortalwrt.org/snapshots/targets/${TARGET_NAME}/${SUBTARGET_NAME}/kmods/")
          fi

          for base_url in "${KMOD_CANDIDATE_URLS[@]}"; do
            KMOD_HTML=$(curl -fsSL --retry 2 --connect-timeout 8 "$base_url" 2>/dev/null || true)
            [ -n "$KMOD_HTML" ] || continue

            CAND_DIR=""
            if [ -n "$FULL_KVER" ]; then
              CAND_DIR=$(printf '%s\n' "$KMOD_HTML" | grep -oE "${FULL_KVER//./\\.}-[0-9]+-[0-9a-f]{32}" | sort -uV | tail -n 1 || true)
            fi
            if [ -z "$CAND_DIR" ] && [ -n "$KMAJOR" ]; then
              CAND_DIR=$(printf '%s\n' "$KMOD_HTML" | grep -oE "${KMAJOR//./\\.}\.[0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9a-f]{32}" | sort -uV | tail -n 1 || true)
            fi
            if [ -z "$CAND_DIR" ] && [[ "$base_url" == *"/releases/${TARGET_VER}/"* ]]; then
              CAND_DIR=$(printf '%s\n' "$KMOD_HTML" | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9a-f]{32}' | sort -uV | tail -n 1 || true)
            fi

            if [ -n "$CAND_DIR" ]; then
              CAND_MAGIC="${CAND_DIR##*-}"
              if [ "${#CAND_MAGIC}" -eq 32 ]; then
                OFFICIAL_KMOD_DIR="$CAND_DIR"
                OFFICIAL_VERMAGIC="$CAND_MAGIC"
                echo "[OK] 匹配官方 kmods 目錄: ${OFFICIAL_KMOD_DIR} (vermagic: ${OFFICIAL_VERMAGIC})"
                break
              fi
            fi
          done

          if [ "${#OFFICIAL_VERMAGIC}" -eq 32 ] && [ -f include/kernel-defaults.mk ]; then
            python3 - "$OFFICIAL_VERMAGIC" << 'PYEOF'
          import re
          import sys

          magic = sys.argv[1]
          path = "include/kernel-defaults.mk"
          with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              content = f.read()

          new_content, n = re.subn(
              r'^(\t).*?\$\(MKHASH\)\s+md5\s*>\s*\$\(LINUX_DIR\)/\.vermagic\b.*$',
              rf"\1echo '{magic}' > $(LINUX_DIR)/.vermagic",
              content,
              flags=re.M
          )
          if n > 0:
              with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  f.write(new_content)
              print(f"[OK] 已將 {path} 核心 vermagic 鎖定為官方值: {magic} (更新 {n} 處)")
          else:
              print("::warning::未在 kernel-defaults.mk 匹配到 .vermagic 規則，保留編譯自動計算值")
          PYEOF
          else
            echo "::warning::未找到核心相符之官方 kmods 目錄，將使用編譯自動生成的 vermagic"
          fi

          mkdir -p files/etc/uci-defaults
          if [ "$ENABLE_BBR" = "Y" ]; then
            mkdir -p files/etc/sysctl.d
            cat > files/etc/sysctl.d/99-turboacc-bbr.conf << 'EOF'
          net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control=bbr
          EOF
          fi

          {
            echo '#!/bin/sh'
            printf "TARGET_VER='%s'\n" "${TARGET_VER}"
            printf "TS_PAIR='%s'\n" "${TS_PAIR}"
            printf "LAN_IP='%s'\n" "${LAN_IP}"
            printf "HOSTNAME_VAL='%s'\n" "${HOSTNAME_VAL}"
